summary: Destructor that walks a linked list rooted at this+0x164, freeing each node's data pointer (when the node flag byte at node+0x8 is non-zero) and each node itself, then clears the four list fields at this+0x164/0x168/0x16C/0x170 to 0. Frees a standalone buffer pointer at this+0x15C when non-null, runs ConditionalDualCleanup on sub-objects at this+0x11C and this+0xE0, chains to the base destructor sub_485EB0, and frees the object itself when the least-significant bit of the flag argument a2 is set.

local_names.this: object being destroyed (owning the list and buffer)
local_names.v3: current node pointer during the linked-list traversal
local_names.v4: node pointer whose data (node+0x0) and node object are freed
local_names.v5: flag byte at node+0x8, zero means the node data is not freed

operations.description: Walk the linked list rooted at this+0x164 while the current node pointer is non-null, reading the next-node pointer at node+0x4 to advance the traversal.
Read the flag byte at node+0x8; when it is zero the node's data pointer is not freed, otherwise the data pointer at node+0x0 is freed first.
Free the node data pointer at node+0x0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the flag byte at node+0x8 is non-zero.
Free each list node object itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf during the traversal.
Clear the four list fields this+0x164, this+0x168, this+0x16C and this+0x170 to 0 after the traversal completes.
When the standalone buffer pointer at this+0x15C is non-null, free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the standalone buffer pointed to by this+0x15C via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Invoke ConditionalDualCleanup on the sub-object at this+0x11C (decimal 284).
Invoke ConditionalDualCleanup on the sub-object at this+0xE0 (decimal 224).
Chain to the base-class destructor sub_485EB0 with this as its argument.
When the least-significant bit of the flag argument a2 is set, free the object itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the object itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf when a2 bit 0 is set (the virtual-delete path).
